source.name: VED-Master (vedmaster.ru) company news: ВЭД-Мастер стал официальным партнером футбольного клуба «Родина»
source.note: The sponsor's own announcement of the 2026/27 partnership; it does not state the exact shirt position, hence the generic 'partner' placement. The club's own announcement (rodina.moscow/news/ved-master-novyi-partner-rodiny-na-sezon-202627, 30 Jul 2026) confirms the deal; Vedomosti (19 Aug 2026, sponsored feature) reported the logo appeared on the match kit.
source.quote: Логотип ВЭД-Мастер появится на игровой форме основной команды

source.name: FC Rodina official site: Vorgol — новый партнёр «Родины»
source.note: Club announcement of Vorgol as official supplier. The shorts placement is not stated in text: it is visible in match photos of the white home kit (e.g. Sports.ru, 'Родина — Акрон: в гости к покорителю Зенита', 12 Aug 2026, photos by Oleg Bukharev / 'В мире спорта', https://www.sports.ru/football/blogs/3437201.html, where the Vorgol logo is printed on the players' shorts).
source.quote: Производитель природной питьевой воды Vorgol стал официальным поставщиком для профессиональных команд и академии

summary: White home shirt of the club's own production, launched 21 Jul 2026 with no shirt sponsors: the launch photos show only the club crest and the RODINA wordmark across the chest. VED-Master (payments, official partner since 30 Jul 2026) has its logo on the match kit per the sponsor's announcement; Vorgol (water) is printed on the shorts per match photos. No title sponsor announced (rplstat.ru still lists it as 'уточняется'); Alfa-Bank names the league (Alfa-Bank RPL) and is recorded as a league-level deal.
